fusions.name: Following Shot
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and slips a packmate after it: for 5 seconds it fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Beaters' Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart out to 7 tiles; each deals 8 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Downwind Blind
fusions.desc: Veils you for 9 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Blood Trail
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
